info.title: UN Mandate Registry API
info.description:
Public, read-only access to documents, extracted paragraphs, budget citations and resolution relationships. No authentication required. Budget citations describe recorded programme-budget references, not legal in-force status. Missing extracted text does not establish that the original document contains no relevant provisions. Resolution collections are related documents, not necessarily ordered versions or legal replacements. Citation context is the selected budget cycle. Extraction and relationship coverage may be incomplete.
Use returned pageUrl/jsonUrl links verbatim. This API does not determine legal in-force status.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Citing entity code, for example `DESA`. `__none__` selects documents with no citing entity.

parameters.name: crossCitingEntity
parameters.description: Second citing entity; intersects entity scope.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search document titles, symbols and subjects using the website search grammar. Up to 500 characters and 32 whitespace-separated terms.

parameters.name: foundational
parameters.description: Set to `true` to select foundational/mandates-and-background citations. Applies to the selected document/entity pair.

parameters.name: budget_location
parameters.description: Structured budget-location scope serialized by website links. Copy this parameter from a filtered website URL.

parameters.name: document_type
parameters.description: Document type label as used in the website.

parameters.name: agenda_scope
parameters.description: Structured agenda scope serialized by website links; takes precedence over `agenda_item`.

parameters.name: related_scope
parameters.description: Related agenda cluster scope; takes precedence over `agenda_scope` and `agenda_item`.

parameters.name: cited
parameters.description: Set to `1` to select only documents cited in the selected budget cycle.

parameters.name: ppb_version
parameters.description: Budget-cycle slug from `/api/v1/reference`. Defaults to the database default; responses identify the resolved cycle.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Set to `1` to group matching versions in list responses. Exports always expand all matching documents.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: `citing_entities_desc` (default), `citing_entities_asc`, `citations_desc`, `citations_asc`, `year_desc`, `year_asc`, `similarity_desc`, `similarity_asc`, `word_count_desc` or `word_count_asc`. Keyword matches rank first; symbol breaks ties.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, default 15, maximum 100; larger values are normalized to 100. Exports ignore `page` and `limit`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Expand the complete selected-cycle sidebar data, independently of search citation filters.

200.description: One page of matching documents. Follow pagination.hasMore; page size does not cap total traversal. An out-of-range page retains total and has no items.

400.description: Malformed or repeated known query parameter, unsupported selector/include/format, or unknown body, session or budget cycle.

503.description: Data temporarily unavailable; retry after 30 seconds.

get.summary: Get a document and its complete details
get.description: The symbol may contain slashes; URL-encode it as a path parameter. Returned jsonUrl points to the equivalent /mandate/{symbol}.json representation.

parameters.name: ppb_version
parameters.description: Budget-cycle slug from `/api/v1/reference`. Defaults to the database default; responses identify the resolved cycle.

200.description: The document, available extracted English paragraphs and selected-cycle sidebar details.

400.description: Malformed or repeated known query parameter, unsupported selector/include/format, or unknown body, session or budget cycle.

503.description: Data temporarily unavailable; retry after 30 seconds.

get.description: The hierarchy shown in the Intergovernmental Agendas tab, including allocations, available meeting counts, subtree resolution counts and related agenda clusters. Defaults to GA and the website’s preferred available session. SC uses a year as its session. Null counts and unavailable status mean missing data, not zero. No pagination or result cap. Serialize a node’s scope as agenda_scope in document search to retrieve its documents.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Session from the returned sessions array; for SC this is a year. Omit to use the same default as the website. Unknown sessions return 400.

200.description: Complete agenda tree, sessions, counts and related items. An empty status means no agenda is available for the body.

400.description: Malformed or repeated known query parameter, unsupported selector/include/format, or unknown body, session or budget cycle.

503.description: Data temporarily unavailable; retry after 30 seconds.

get.summary: Browse entities, programmes and budget locations
get.description: The complete Entities and Programmes tab data: a flat tree keyed by id/parentId, document counts, expenditure matches keyed by row ID, and programme clusters. Includes official locations without citations. Serves only the latest available budget cycle, matching this tab; the response identifies that cycle. Historical cycles are not supported and ppb_version selectors return 400. No pagination or result cap. Expenditure amounts are budget-location figures, not allocations to documents.

200.description: Complete entity/programme tree, latest-cycle metadata, expenditure matches and cluster membership.

400.description: Malformed or repeated known query parameter, unsupported selector/include/format, or unknown body, session or budget cycle.

503.description: Data temporarily unavailable; retry after 30 seconds.

get.summary: Get entities, organs, programme hierarchy and budget cycles

parameters.name: ppb_version
parameters.description: Budget-cycle slug from `/api/v1/reference`. Defaults to the database default; responses identify the resolved cycle.

200.description: Reference codes and programme hierarchy for the selected cycle.

400.description: Malformed or repeated known query parameter, unsupported selector/include/format, or unknown body, session or budget cycle.

503.description: Data temporarily unavailable; retry after 30 seconds.

get.description: Streamed download with no total result cap. CSV has a standard column header without repeated file-level metadata; metadata is included in Excel/JSON. JSON downloads use indented regular JSON. Ignores page/limit and expands grouped versions. JSON supports include=details. Excel contains Documents, Budget citations, Version relationships and About this export sheets. Live batches are not a frozen database snapshot. A failed stream is an incomplete download and must be retried.

resolutionCount.description: Null means the count is unavailable; zero is a known empty result. Counts include the item subtree.

citationAvailable.description: False for official locations without a citation-backed document scope.

expenditures.description: Expenditure matches keyed by row ID. Amounts describe budget locations, not individual documents. Preserve period, status and provenance.
